instruction: A candid, intimate close-up photograph set indoors against a plain light grey wall. The curly-haired woman in a white ribbed top (R1) stands on the left, eyes closed, holding the girl with straight dark hair (R2) close. The girl in a beige ribbed top (R2) leans her head against the woman's chest, looking down in a moment of quiet comfort. The woman's arm is wrapped around the girl's back in a warm, protective embrace. Soft, diffused side lighting illuminates the scene, creating a gentle, calm mood with a neutral color palette of white, beige, and grey.
